description: Representative, stable, sanitized regression cases for the vault's high-frequency reading-note pipeline skills. Fixtures live under .llm/prompt-cache/fixtures/. Baselines are null until first measured run.

quality_checks: Every sentence of the source passage is preserved verbatim; nothing removed or added.
Obsidian headings use a space after '#' (e.g. '# Title', not '#Title').
Paragraphs are separated by exactly one blank line.
YAML frontmatter is present with simple string/list values only.
Each English paragraph is followed by its Chinese translation, separated by a blank line.
The full English source is preserved; no paragraph merged or dropped.
YAML frontmatter uses type: translation and the provided topic.
No explanatory content is added outside '> [!note]' blocks.
Grammar points are grouped into flat '### 从句：定语从句' style headings, not nested '####' sub-entries.
Teaching details (terms, etymology notes, examples, exam context) are preserved.
Callouts and tables are valid; every table has a blank line before it.
Related grammar points are grouped in one section even if from different sentences.

sentences: The problem of teacher shortage has become more acute as school districts across the country struggle to fill classrooms with qualified instructors.
Teachers, who once enjoyed considerable autonomy in the classroom, now find themselves accountable to standardized tests, parental demands, and administrative oversight.

quality_checks: Each analysis callout begins with '> **原句**：' followed by the full English sentence.
主干提取 uses the '- 中文名 缩写: 内容' format (e.g. '- 主语 S: ...').
Every table inside a callout has a blank line before it.
Multiple sentences use the alternating original-sentence/callout structure.
All template sections are present: 背景, 文章原文, 翻译对照, 语法要点, 心得, 延伸, 思考题, 相关笔记.
Exactly one '<!-- VOCABULARY_SLOT -->' appears before the 心得 section.
Inline '> [!abstract]-' long-sentence callouts stay in 文章原文 after their sentence; none are moved to a summary section.
YAML frontmatter uses simple strings and lists.
'<!-- VOCABULARY_SLOT -->' is replaced by both '## 生词表' and '### 生词练习'.
Vocabulary entries are deduplicated and sorted; words inside phrases also get standalone entries.
No invented words; a zero-vocabulary result is reported honestly.
No other content in the note is modified.
